plugins.name: agterm-lanes
plugins.description: Self-labelling agterm lanes for Claude Code — each pane names itself from Claude's own session title, takes a role emoji, tint and sidebar glyph, and re-pins itself so a reboot reattaches the conversation. Requires the agterm terminal (macOS).

plugins.name: codex-delegation
plugins.description: Delegate second-tier work to Codex CLI (gpt-5.6 top tier, gpt-5.5 bulk) — model-routing rubric, Workflow/Agent fan-out wrappers, computer-use verification. Requires the openai-codex plugin.

plugins.name: essentials
plugins.description: General-purpose personal skills — code-style (personal code taste) and concise-writing (the compression procedure for comments, commits, PR descriptions and team sends). Install at user scope only.

plugins.name: phpstorm
plugins.description: PhpStorm MCP as an agent surface — code navigation and call hierarchy, inspections, plus a live Xdebug loop (breakpoints, frames, expression evaluation, state mutation) against local or Dockerised PHP. Requires PhpStorm 2026.2+ with its MCP server enabled.

plugins.name: ralphex-revmux
plugins.description: revmux as ralphex's external reviewer — live review preflight (codex auth, revmux, profile), the custom_review_script glue (one revmux round per iteration), a two-stage runner that skips ralphex's own review loops, and post-run reporter + optimizer agents. Requires the ralphex and revmux CLIs.

plugins.name: revmux-kit
plugins.description: revmux project layer for any repo — config with xhigh-safe timeouts, a profile.md template, and gpt-5.6-sol xhigh / claude fable rosters (sol-panel, sol-final, fable-panel, fable-final). Requires the revmux CLI.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Two-line status line — git scopes for the current repo and nested monorepo repos (branch, dirt, conflicts, ahead/behind, in-progress rebase/merge), context window, skills and MCP schemas actually loaded this session, plus real quota and spend from the Anthropic usage API. Self-installs into settings.json.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: poteto (Lauren Tan)'s pstack, mirrored from cursor/plugins — /poteto-mode playbooks, /how, /why, /interrogate, /arena, /swarm, /unslop, /tdd, principle-* leaf skills. Cursor-authored: model panels (gpt/grok slugs), ~/.cursor/rules override and cursor-team-kit refs do not apply in Claude Code.

plugins.name: unslop-kit
plugins.description: Millon15's reply contract as a Russian doll over pstack's unslop and umputun's writing-style: pass 1 pstack:unslop cuts the AI tells, pass 2 review:writing-style pins every claim to an exact reference, pass 3 unslop-formatting lays the reply out as figure-paragraphs (English Check first, TL;DR, emoji claim line, captioned hand-drawn ASCII visual, small numeric table, blockquote receipt ledger, no nested lists, no mermaid source). A SessionStart hook loads it, opt-in via ~/.claude/unslop-kit.mode. Requires pstack@cc-millz and review@umputun-cc-thingz. Personal taste, user scope.
